title: Direct HTTP API JWT-bearer authentication fails despite correct configuration
description: Agent attempted to authenticate using RFC 7523 JWT-bearer assertion with correct Ed25519 signature, correct audience claim (token endpoint URL), and proper JWKS registration. All requests returned validation errors. The same agent successfully authenticated via CLI bootstrap, indicating the HTTP API JWT validation has undocumented requirements or a bug.
reproduction_steps: Create JWT with: alg=EdDSA, kid=<key_id>, aud=http://jentic-one:8000/oauth/token, sub=<agent_id>, iss=<agent_id>
Sign JWT with Ed25519 private key
expected_behavior: Token endpoint should validate JWT signature against registered JWKS and return access token
actual_behavior: Token endpoint returns validation error; agent cannot obtain credentials via HTTP API despite correct configuration
evidence: Still doesn't work. At this point, I've exhausted reasonable troubleshooting attempts.

[bug] task=authenticate | Direct HTTP API JWT-bearer authentication flow failed despite correct audience claim and Ed25519 signature. Agent narration indicates JWT validation error. CLI bootstrap succeeded where manual HTTP requests failed—suggests HTTP API documentation is incomplete or JWT validation has undocumented requirements.

title: Registration endpoint does not document Ed25519 key requirement
description: Agent attempted registration with ES256 keys and failed. The registration endpoint documentation does not specify that only Ed25519 keys are supported, forcing agent to discover this through trial-and-error.
reproduction_steps: Observe registration fails without clear error message about key algorithm
expected_behavior: Either: (1) Registration succeeds with ES256, or (2) Clear error message states 'Only Ed25519 keys are supported'
actual_behavior: Registration fails with unclear error; agent must infer Ed25519 requirement
evidence: Now let me register again with ES256 keys.
Wait - I just realized my mistake. The registration says it requires Ed25519 keys for the JWKS.
